items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: And he used to go play in Oylos Trepanion's place, you know, sometimes.

ctx.x: Yeah. Oylos played a lot of times in his job. You know, at night, he would come ass on to go play. You know, sometime, one time I think he was playing at that about three times a week. And he used to go play in Oylos Trepanion's place, you know, sometimes. I don't remember him, eh? So...
Where were you born? I wanted to ask you about that.
